dispositionPolicy.policy: Every licensed community FunctionUnit is bound by exact ID to one reviewed KLM capability. Classification runs only during policy generation; runtime and census resolution is exact and fail closed. Native primary means the typed KLM operation has a specific action binding and is executable against canonical tenant-owned state. Native shadow preserves an exact contract but only permits inspection and simulation until its semantics are resolved. Promotion to native_verified is per unit and requires an independent pinned-source oracle; no global manifest may promote the whole catalog.

definition: A FunctionUnit is a public behavior observable through API, UI, job, webhook, MCP, realtime, permission, configuration, import, or export boundaries. Internal helpers and excluded proprietary trees are not denominator units.

verificationManifest.claimBoundary: Registry and source evidence are validated by the census. Runtime proof is generated locally and is not committed as repository source.
